MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The SanDisk microSD card fits my repeated use of memory cards, and its adapter makes it useful with my existing card reader.",
    "The flash drive and USB extension cables support carrying photos, transferring files, and reaching my accessories more easily.",
    "The Fire TV Stick connects with my television use, although I would check compatibility and whether it adds something useful alongside my DVD player."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Internal SSDs, a desktop hard drive, and desktop memory require a computer upgrade need I have not expressed; my storage purchases have centered on removable cards and practical accessories.",
    "Buying surge protectors does not mean I currently need computer battery backup.",
    "My DVD player makes an RCA cable conceivable, but it does not establish a need for a 25-foot cable."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in memory cards seems to have been stretched into an interest in storage hardware of any kind, even when installation and intended use differ substantially.",
    "Owning electronics seems to have been treated as a reason to suggest upgrades and specialized accessories without a clear connection to what I am trying to do."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of cards, adapters, holders, and cables suggest that compatibility and convenient use with devices I already own matter to me.",
    "My recent lens cap purchase and earlier tripod purchases keep camera accessories relevant to my interests.",
    "A related item still needs to solve a specific problem: connector type, cable length, and whether it adds a useful capability affect my choice."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my need for practical device accessories but stretched that interest into computer upgrades without evidence of a current need."
}
